Six days ago, Apple released the iOS 27.2 developer beta 1, skipping iOS 27.1 beta. Following yesterday's release of developer beta 2, Apple has now launched the first public beta of iOS 27.2, which includes a brand-new iPhone Health App. Apple has also enabled the ability to book and purchase lab testing services through Quest Diagnostics from the new Health App in the iOS 27.2 beta.

iOS 27.2 beta includes all-new Health App and more

iOS 27.2 will be the next version after iOS 27 officially launched on September 14. iOS 27.1 is only available for iPhone Duo.

Apple has detailed how the iOS 27.1 SDK lets developers take full advantage of the iPhone Duo display. You can learn here how apps display on iPhone Duo when targeting different iOS versions.

Apple released Xcode 27.1 beta on Friday, adding iPhone Duo simulator and support for developing apps for the new foldable iPhone.

The first iOS 27.2 developer beta includes the following changes:

  • The redesigned Health App, first unveiled by Apple at the iPhone 18 Pro launch event, officially debuts in this beta.
  • Dual-camera shooting mode arrives in Group FaceTime.
  • Siri AI language support now adds French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Apple TV App profile feature arrives on iPhone.
  • In Apple Podcasts, "Up Next" has been renamed to "Latest Episodes", and the "Continue Listening" section now sits directly below "Latest Episodes". The episode list in Podcasts also now uses a background that matches the topic color.
  • Apple Music now uses less accent color for in-app icons.

iOS 27.2 is expected to officially launch in October. iPhone users who want to try the all-new Apple Health App early can do so through both the developer beta and public beta.
